title: S4-HIST-04 — Resize bounds are real.
goal: The canvas size fields admit only 4 to 512 pixels: a typed 0 becomes 4 when the field is left, a typed 513 becomes 512 when Enter is pressed, and Cancel leaves the 16x16 Bun exactly as it was without allocating anything.

steps.why: Leaving the field commits what was typed.
0 is clamped to the minimum 4 once committed.
513 is clamped to the maximum 512 once committed.
Cancel leaves the original drawing exactly as it was.
